templateChecks.label: It shows one adult, alone in the frame
templateChecks.fix: Crop to one person, or pick a photo where they stand alone. Group shots confuse the model about who the star is.

templateChecks.label: It is me, or someone who said yes
templateChecks.fix: Ask first. Do not upload footballers, celebrities, children or anyone who has not agreed.

templateChecks.label: The face is clear and roughly facing the camera
templateChecks.fix: Skip sunglasses, masks and caps pulled low. A side profile or a tiny face far away often comes out as a stranger.

templateChecks.label: Even light: daylight or a bright room
templateChecks.fix: Harsh shadows and dark rooms hide the features the model needs. Retake by a window if you can.

templateChecks.label: The outfit is visible, ideally head to toe
templateChecks.fix: A tight face crop gives the model nothing to dress you in. The outfit is half the joke.

templateChecks.label: Not wearing a plain sports top or a team shirt
templateChecks.fix: Sportswear blends into the players around you. A suit, a cardigan or a loud jumper stands out far more.

photoChecks.ask: Is the person an adult who agreed to this?
photoChecks.fix: Only use photos of adults who said yes. No children, footballers or celebrities.

photoChecks.ask: Is there only one person in the photo?
photoChecks.fix: Crop out everyone else, or pick a solo shot. Group photos confuse the model about who the star is.

photoChecks.ask: Is the face clear and turned roughly towards the camera?
photoChecks.fix: Choose a photo where the face is sharp and not in profile, so the result still looks like them.

photoChecks.ask: Are the eyes free of sunglasses, a mask or a low cap?
photoChecks.fix: Pick a shot without sunglasses, masks or a peak over the eyes. These hide what makes a face recognisable.

photoChecks.ask: Is the light even, without harsh shadows or a bright window behind?
photoChecks.fix: Daylight or a bright room works best. Backlit or very dark photos lose detail in the face and clothes.

photoChecks.ask: Can you see most of the outfit, ideally head to toe?
photoChecks.fix: A full or three-quarter shot lets the model keep the clothes. A tight face crop means it has to guess them.

photoChecks.ask: Is the top something other than a plain green or white sports top?
photoChecks.fix: Plain green or white sportswear can be read as football kit and spoil the contrast. Everyday clothes work better.

beatExplanations.look: The keeper commits early and flies past.
beatExplanations.lands: The scale of the dive. A whole professional-looking keeper is beaten before the person has done anything.

beatExplanations.look: The ball drops onto the chest and stays under control.
beatExplanations.lands: The touch. This is the “Ozil bounce” people name the trend after, and it is funnier the less sporty the person looks.

beatExplanations.look: A defender slides in, misses and is left on the grass.
beatExplanations.lands: The run on. The person keeps going as if this happens every weekend, still in their own clothes.
